using Base

mutable struct Vec3Array
    x::Array{Float32}
    y::Array{Float32}
    z::Array{Float32}
    
    function Vec3Array(x::Array{T}, y::Array{T}, z::Array{T}) where T <: AbstractFloat
        if !(eltype(x) == eltype(y) == eltype(z))
            error("Type mismatch: $(eltype(x)), $(eltype(y)), $(eltype(z))")
        end
        if !(size(x) == size(y) == size(z))
            error("Shape mismatch: $(size(x)), $(size(y)), $(size(z))")
        end
        new(Float32.(x), Float32.(y), Float32.(z))
    end
    
    Vec3Array(x::Real, y::Real, z::Real) = new(Float32[x], Float32[y], Float32[z])
end

Base.:+(v1::Vec3Array, v2::Vec3Array) = Vec3Array(v1.x .+ v2.x, v1.y .+ v2.y, v1.z .+ v2.z)

Base.:-(v1::Vec3Array, v2::Vec3Array) = Vec3Array(v1.x .- v2.x, v1.y .- v2.y, v1.z .- v2.z)

Base.:*(v::Vec3Array, scalar::Real) = Vec3Array(v.x .* scalar, v.y .* scalar, v.z .* scalar)

Base.:*(scalar::Real, v::Vec3Array) = v * scalar

Base.:/(v::Vec3Array, scalar::Real) = Vec3Array(v.x ./ scalar, v.y ./ scalar, v.z ./ scalar)

Base.:-(v::Vec3Array) = Vec3Array(-v.x, -v.y, -v.z)

Base.:+(v::Vec3Array) = Vec3Array(v.x, v.y, v.z)

function cross(v1::Vec3Array, v2::Vec3Array)::Vec3Array
    new_x = v1.y .* v2.z .- v1.z .* v2.y
    new_y = v1.z .* v2.x .- v1.x .* v2.z
    new_z = v1.x .* v2.y .- v1.y .* v2.x
    return Vec3Array(new_x, new_y, new_z)
end

function dot(v1::Vec3Array, v2::Vec3Array)
    return v1.x .* v2.x .+ v1.y .* v2.y .+ v1.z .* v2.z
end

function norm(v::Vec3Array; epsilon::Float64=1e-6)
    norm2_val = dot(v, v)
    if epsilon > 0
        norm2_val = max.(norm2_val, epsilon^2)
    end
    return sqrt.(norm2_val)
end

function norm2(v::Vec3Array)
    return dot(v, v)
end

function normalized(v::Vec3Array; epsilon::Float64=1e-6)::Vec3Array
    return v / norm(v, epsilon=epsilon)
end

function zeros(::Type{Vec3Array}, shape::Tuple, dtype::Type=Float32)
    return Vec3Array(zeros(dtype, shape), zeros(dtype, shape), zeros(dtype, shape))
end

function zeros(::Type{Vec3Array}, shape::Int, dtype::Type=Float32)
    return Vec3Array(zeros(dtype, shape), zeros(dtype, shape), zeros(dtype, shape))
end

function to_array(v::Vec3Array)
    return cat(v.x, v.y, v.z, dims=ndims(v.x)+1)
end

function from_array(::Type{Vec3Array}, arr::Array)
    x = selectdim(arr, ndims(arr), 1)
    y = selectdim(arr, ndims(arr), 2)
    z = selectdim(arr, ndims(arr), 3)
    return Vec3Array(x, y, z)
end

function square_euclidean_distance(vec1::Vec3Array, vec2::Vec3Array; epsilon::Float64=1e-6)
    difference = vec1 - vec2
    distance = dot(difference, difference)
    if epsilon > 0
        distance = max.(distance, epsilon)
    end
    return distance
end

function euclidean_distance(vec1::Vec3Array, vec2::Vec3Array; epsilon::Float64=1e-6)
    distance_sq = square_euclidean_distance(vec1, vec2, epsilon=epsilon^2)
    distance = sqrt.(distance_sq)
    return distance
end

function dihedral_angle(a::Vec3Array, b::Vec3Array, c::Vec3Array, d::Vec3Array)
    v1 = a - b
    v2 = b - c
    v3 = d - c
    c1 = cross(v1, v2)
    c2 = cross(v3, v2)
    c3 = cross(c2, c1)
    v2_mag = norm(v2)
    return atan.(dot(c3, v2), v2_mag .* dot(c1, c2))
end

function random_gaussian_vector(shape::Tuple, key=nothing, dtype::Type=Float32)::Vec3Array
    if length(shape) == 0
        vec_array = randn(dtype, 3)
    else
        vec_array = randn(dtype, shape..., 3)
    end
    return from_array(Vec3Array, vec_array)
end

using LinearAlgebra

@enum DotPrecision begin
    F32_F32
    DEFAULT
end

mutable struct Precision
    operand_dtype::DataType
    accumulator_dtype::DataType
end

function get_dot_precision(backend::String, precision::DotPrecision)::String
    if backend == "gpu" && precision == F32_F32
        return "HIGHEST"
    end
    return "DEFAULT"
end

function einsum_with_dot_precision(subscript::String, a::Array, b::Array; precision::Precision)
    a_converted = convert(Array{precision.operand_dtype}, a)
    b_converted = convert(Array{precision.operand_dtype}, b)
    
    if subscript == "...qhd,...khd->...hqk"
        dims_a = size(a_converted)
        dims_b = size(b_converted)
        
        if length(dims_a) == 4 && length(dims_b) == 4
            batch_size = dims_a[1]
            q_len = dims_a[2]
            num_heads = dims_a[3]
            d_model = dims_a[4]
            k_len = dims_b[2]
            
            result = zeros(precision.accumulator_dtype, batch_size, num_heads, q_len, k_len)
            for b in 1:batch_size
                for h in 1:num_heads
                    for q in 1:q_len
                        for k in 1:k_len
                            sum_val = zero(precision.accumulator_dtype)
                            for d in 1:d_model
                                sum_val += a_converted[b, q, h, d] * b_converted[b, k, h, d]
                            end
                            result[b, h, q, k] = sum_val
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return result
        else
            error("Unsupported dimensions for einsum")
        end
        
    elseif subscript == "...hqk,...khd->...qhd"
        dims_a = size(a_converted)
        dims_b = size(b_converted)
        
        if length(dims_a) == 4 && length(dims_b) == 4
            batch_size = dims_a[1]
            num_heads = dims_a[2]
            q_len = dims_a[3]
            k_len = dims_a[4]
            d_model = dims_b[4]
            
            result = zeros(precision.accumulator_dtype, batch_size, q_len, num_heads, d_model)
            for b in 1:batch_size
                for q in 1:q_len
                    for h in 1:num_heads
                        for d in 1:d_model
                            sum_val = zero(precision.accumulator_dtype)
                            for k in 1:k_len
                                sum_val += a_converted[b, h, q, k] * b_converted[b, k, h, d]
                            end
                            result[b, q, h, d] = sum_val
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return result
        else
            error("Unsupported dimensions for einsum")
        end
    else
        error("Unsupported einsum subscript: $subscript")
    end
end

function softmax(x::Array)::Array
    dtype = promote_type(eltype(x), Float32)
    x_typed = convert(Array{dtype}, x)
    x_max = maximum(x_typed, dims=ndims(x_typed), keepdims=true)
    unnormalized = exp.(x_typed .- x_max)
    denom = sum(unnormalized, dims=ndims(unnormalized), keepdims=true)
    return unnormalized ./ denom
end

function attend(
    q::Array,
    k::Array,
    v::Array;
    q_k_dot_precision::Precision,
    logits_dtype::DataType,
    logits_scale::Float64,
    bias::Union{Array, Nothing},
    mask::Union{Array, Nothing},
    weights_v_dot_precision::Precision,
    q_indices::Union{Array, Nothing}=nothing,
    k_indices::Union{Array, Nothing}=nothing
)::Array
    
    logits = einsum_with_dot_precision("...qhd,...khd->...hqk", q, k, precision=q_k_dot_precision)
    logits = convert(Array{logits_dtype}, logits)
    logits = logits .* logits_scale
    
    if !isnothing(bias)
        logits = logits .+ bias
    end
    
    if !isnothing(mask)
        q_len_or_indices = isnothing(q_indices) ? size(q)[end-2] : q_indices
        k_len_or_indices = isnothing(k_indices) ? size(k)[end-2] : k_indices
        
        if !isnothing(mask)
            mask_value = floatmin(logits_dtype)
            logits = ifelse.(mask, logits, mask_value)
        end
    end
    
    weights = softmax(logits)
    weights = convert(Array{eltype(v)}, weights)
    
    out = einsum_with_dot_precision("...hqk,...khd->...qhd", weights, v, precision=weights_v_dot_precision)
    out = convert(Array{eltype(q)}, out)
    
    return out
end

mutable struct XlaDotProductAttention
    function XlaDotProductAttention()
        new()
    end
end

function fwd(
    self::XlaDotProductAttention,
    q::Array,
    k::Array,
    v::Array;
    q_k_dot_precision::Precision,
    logits_dtype::DataType,
    logits_scale::Float64,
    bias::Union{Array, Nothing},
    mask::Union{Array, Nothing},
    weights_v_dot_precision::Precision,
    q_indices::Union{Array, Nothing}=nothing,
    k_indices::Union{Array, Nothing}=nothing
)::Array
    
    return attend(
        q,
        k,
        v,
        bias=bias,
        mask=mask,
        q_indices=q_indices,
        k_indices=k_indices,
        q_k_dot_precision=q_k_dot_precision,
        logits_dtype=logits_dtype,
        logits_scale=logits_scale,
        weights_v_dot_precision=weights_v_dot_precision
    )
end
